newsitem.title: USA: IES Industries Q1 hurt by weather.
newsitem.headline: IES Industries Q1 hurt by weather.

text.p: IES Industries Inc said milder than normal weather in the first quarter compared with colder than normal weather a year earlier reduced earnings by an estimated $0.06 per share.

During the 1997 quarter, IES Utilities reported an eight percent decrease in the volume of natural gas sold and transported for customers, compared with the volume of the first quarter of 1996. It said this decrease primarily reflects the effect of weather on residential gas sales.
When compared to "normal" weather, natural gas sales were down three percent from sales of the previous year.
Earlier Thursday, IES Industries posted first-quarter earnings of $12.3 million or $0.41 per share, down from $14.1 million or $0.48 per share a year ago.
